CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

2. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   B. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.

5. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

8. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Damage equipment used for Photography.

9. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

11. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
